basic_info.description: Enjoy in this condo a semi-open plan living/dining/kitchen area with wood burning fireplace. There is a wall of shelving in the living area to place your favorite photos, books, art pieces, etc. Semi-open dining area that could also be used for a home office space. The galley style kitchen has granite countertops, refrigerator, electric stove, microwave, dishwasher and disposal. Generously sized bedroom with walk-in closet. The windows let in lots of natural light into each room. 1 bathroom with shower over tub. 1 parking space in the garage. Laundry in the building. Easy access to nearby shopping centers, public transportation, restaurants, including Metreon Center and Yerba Buena Gardens. Property is aka 180 7th Street #305.
